groups.name: super-controller.openapi
groups.description: Configuration properties for OpenAPI documentation generation.

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.default-version
properties.description: The default version to use when none is specified.

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.strategy
properties.description: The strategy for extracting version from request (URI, HEADER, PARAMETER, ACCEPT_HEADER).

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.header-name
properties.description: The header name when using HEADER strategy.

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.param-name
properties.description: The parameter name when using PARAMETER strategy.

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.media-type-prefix
properties.description: The media type prefix when using ACCEPT_HEADER strategy.

properties.name: super-controller.versioning.add-deprecation-headers
properties.description: Whether to add deprecation headers to responses for deprecated API versions.

properties.name: super-controller.openapi.enabled
properties.description: Whether OpenAPI documentation generation is enabled.

properties.name: super-controller.openapi.title
properties.description: The title of the API documentation.

values.description: Version specified in custom header (e.g., X-API-Version: v1).
Version specified in Accept header using vendor media type (e.g., Accept: application/vnd.api.v1+json).
